claims: UFC Freedom 250 event is scheduled for June 14, 2026.
UFC Freedom 250 event location is the South Lawn of the White House in Washington, D.C.
UFC Freedom 250 event is headlined by a lightweight title unification bout between champion Ilia Topuria and interim champion Justin Gaethje.
UFC Freedom 250 card features Alex Pereira vs. Ciryl Gane for the interim heavyweight title.
Ilia Topuria (c) vs. Justin Gaethje (ic) is the main event lightweight title bout for UFC Freedom 250.
Alex Pereira vs. Ciryl Gane is the co-main event interim heavyweight title bout for UFC Freedom 250.
Sean O'Malley vs. Aiemann Zahabi is a bantamweight bout on the UFC Freedom 250 main card.
Mauricio Ruffy vs. Michael Chandler is a lightweight bout on the UFC Freedom 250 main card.
Bo Nickal vs. Kyle Daukaus is a middleweight bout on the UFC Freedom 250 main card.
Diego Lopes vs. Steve Garcia is a featherweight bout on the UFC Freedom 250 main card.
UFC Freedom 250 event is meant to celebrate the 250th anniversary of U.S. independence.
UFC is planning to issue 85,000 free tickets for an outdoor viewing experience at the Ellipse.
Association of Boxing Commissions will provide regulatory oversight for UFC Freedom 250 due to the location on federal land.
Jon Jones was reportedly in talks to fight on the UFC Freedom 250 card but is not included.
Conor McGregor is not on the announced lineup for UFC Freedom 250.
UFC Freedom 250 event is dubbed 'UFC Freedom Fights 250'
